rules: component families are requirements placeholders, not procurement specifications
no manufacturer, part number, price, stock, lead time or supplier has been selected
critical frame, motion, thermal and safety functions must not rely on unqualified printed components
safety-related component architecture requires machinery risk assessment and competent review
unknown supply or qualification status remains unknown and blocks procurement or release

systems.name: Frame, panels and structural joining
components: No profile series, alloy, temper, section or joint system selected.
Corner plates, gussets and structural fasteners
Joint stiffness, preload, slip and fatigue must be calculated.
Stiffness and mode shape need verification.
Material, temperature rating, visibility, fire behaviour and sealing need review.

systems.name: XY motion and gantry
components: Rail class, preload, straightness, parallelism and mounting interface not selected.
Belt type, width, pitch, tension and fatigue envelope not selected.
Torque-speed, thermal load, driver compatibility and holding behaviour not selected.
Mass, stiffness, cooling, service access and cable bend life not defined.

systems.name: Z stage and build platform
components: Z actuators / lead screws / belts / motors
Architecture A/B/C trade study remains open.
Parallelism, racking and thermal expansion requirements open.
Build surface, heater and support assembly
Flatness, thermal uniformity, electrical isolation and support stiffness open.

systems.name: Material extrusion toolhead
components: Supported filament types, torque, wear and feed consistency not selected.
Heater block, heat break, nozzle and thermal path
Operating temperature, materials and thermal protection need review.
Sensor type, wiring, failure mode and independent thermal protection required.
Airflow and material process envelope not defined.

systems.name: Power distribution and control
components: Electrical rating, protection, isolation, protective bonding and conformity route open.
Open interfaces, sourcing, firmware support, thermal design and fault handling open.
Wiring harness, connectors, glands and strain relief
Wire gauge, temperature rating, routing and protective coordination open.
Design and verification per applicable electrical/machinery requirements.
Ratings and coordination depend on final circuit design.
Fail-safe behavior and independent protection to be engineered.
Function and required category determined by risk assessment; button presence alone is not proof.
Selection and safety integrity based on risk assessment and machine design.
Temperature, airflow, life, noise and failure detection not selected.

systems.name: Enclosure, emissions and thermal management
components: Source capture, ducting and extraction interface
No household operation until exact printer/material/site control envelope reviewed.
Filter media / enclosure filtration where selected
Filter type, efficiency, pressure drop, replacement and exposure measurement open.
Monitoring is not itself protective control; sensor limits and failure states open.

systems.name: Firmware, user interface and local operation
components: Exact release, license, safety limits, update and rollback policy open.
Display / local controls / offline job interface
No mandatory cloud/account; safe local control is proposed requirement.
Bind BOM, firmware, calibration, process profile and maintenance records.

components: Reference artefact and inspection method must be specified; printed artifact is not automatically a calibrated standard.
Instrument selection, range, resolution, calibration and measurement uncertainty open.
Tools, cleaning, lubrication and service spares
Service task analysis and common tool standardization open.
